title: J-35A tells world China is a formidable challenger
description: PLA Air Force unveiled the J-35A at Zhuhai Airshow. The stealth aircraft complements China's J-20, known for its long-range capabilities.

title: World leaders seek stability with China as US transitions to Trump
description: Potential conflicts with China loom on human rights, the fate of Taiwan, technology competition, cyber attacks, aid to Russia and tariffs.

title: US Weapon Stockpiles Under Strain Amid Global Tensions
description: US military's stockpiles are depleted due to conflicts in Ukraine and the Middle East, affecting its ability to respond to potential conflicts in the Indo-Pacific. Admiral Samuel Paparo highlighted concerns about the military's readiness if tensions with China escalate, especially concerning Taiwan's defense.

title: Numerous children injured by a vehicle at a school gate in central China
description: TAIPEI, Taiwan (AP) — Numerous children were injured by a vehicle at the gate of an elementary school in central China’s Hunan province on Tuesday morning, reports said. Students were arriving for classes around 8 a.m.
